text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
The committee meeting ran late, so I'm 
behind schedule! 
...Hm? Is that Biko-san?

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Biko-san, what's the matter? It's time for 
our investigation—

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Ah, yeah! I was just doing some review. 
I'm all done now, so let's go together!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
You dropped something. 
Is this... a test?

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Waaahhh!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
D-Did you see...? ...It's a terrible 
score, isn't it? 
I did study, but... this was the best 
score I could get.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
And on top of that, trying to hide it... 
that's so uncool of me! 
It's just, it's so embarrassing. Stuff 
like this—

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: —isn't like a hero at all...!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
...Do you really think so? 
I think it's wonderful, actually.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
You wanted to hide it because you know you 
can't stay as you are. 
In other words, it's the other side of 
your ambition. That is truly an admirable 
mindset!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Biko-san. 
Even now, you possess the true heart of a 
hero!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: The heart of a hero... Me...?

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: ...I see... Hehe... You're right...!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... I feel a lot better. All right, 
let's go investigate! 
I'll see our assigned mission through to 
the end! After all—I'm a hero!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
(...Hmm, something about this shelf is 
bothering me... 
Huh? The papers sticking out of this 
file... are really crumpled up?)

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
—Look, check this out! 
Could this be a clue left by the 
intruder?!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
All the papers sticking out were so 
crinkled, it caught my eye! 
They were shoved in so sloppily, just like 
my test papers...!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
This is... the race record sheet from last 
week?! 
It's far too new to be something stored in 
the archive. Which means—

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Ah! There's a circle around a name on the 
race record!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
! She's our intruder...! 
If we question her, we'll find out what 
she was after!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Splendid work, Biko-san! 
We shall immediately proceed to conduct a 
voluntary interview with this Umamusume, 
ma'am!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Regarding the Umamusume in question, we 
have obtained intel that 
she is at the billiards hall today. Let us 
head there at once.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Fenomeno, are you seriously going dressed 
like that? 
You look way too stiff! Everyone's gonna 
think the Disciplinary Committee is on 
patrol!

text_block_list.name: Samson Big
text_block_list.text:
That's true! Captain, you have such a 
strong presence, you really stand out! 
How about we go find some casual clothes 
so you can blend in?

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
—Here's the outfit I recommend! 
Heheh, I based it on a superhero before 
they transform! Pretty cool, right?!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
The pants Biko picked aren't bad. But the 
top is way too plain... 
It'd look great paired with this super 
flashy shirt♪

text_block_list.name: Samson Big
text_block_list.text:
And then we add the accessories Urara-chan 
and I picked out! 
What do you think? Doesn't it look 
awesome?!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Waaaow! Captain, you look so cool!! 
So jealous, I wanna try wearing clothes 
like that too!

text_block_list.name: Shop Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, would you like to try them on? 
Please feel free to use the fitting room. 
If you like them, we can hold them for you 
as well.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Then I want to try them on too! 
Hehe, I've always wanted to wear mature 
clothes like this...♪

text_block_list.name: Samson Big
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Captain! Stay right next to Biko-chan 
just like that! 
...Yup, the balance is perfect! Captain's 
coordination is complete~!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
So this is... what you all chose, thinking 
it would suit me... 
Fufu, this is certainly an outfit I could 
never have picked on my own.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
I'm learning so many new things from all 
of you. 
I will do my best on this undercover 
investigation to live up to this outfit!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
(The one at the counter is the Umamusume 
named on the race record. 
...I also spot a few other familiar faces 
I've had to discipline in the past.)

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
(Fortunately, it seems I've blended in 
without being recognized as a committee 
member... 
First, I shall attempt to gather 
information by listening in on nearby 
conversations.)

text_block_list.name: Umamusume on the Record Board
text_block_list.text:
Have you been to the archive room lately? 
Word is, 
Fenomeno from the Disciplinary Committee 
has been poking around there.

text_block_list.name: Habitual Sneaking Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I saw her! It's gotta be an 
investigation by the committee, right? 
Total disaster! 
Just in case, I went and took back 
everything I'd hidden behind the wall!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume on the Record Board
text_block_list.text:
Seriously?! Mine are still in there! Ugh, 
big mistake. 
I mean, once you shove stuff behind that 
wall, you never really open it back up...

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
(I see... There is a hidden space behind 
the wall in the archive room! 
If we investigate there, we might uncover 
the purpose of their intrusion!)

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: ——! T-This is...!!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
There are tons of crumpled papers and 
tattered books in here!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
A large number of personal belongings in 
the space behind the wall...! 
This serves as physical evidence that 
other intruders were present.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Severely damaged books and documents. 
Deducing from these race-related abandoned 
items, 
their purpose was:—

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
They hid things related to their 
defeats... because they didn't want to 
look at them. 
Someone's race results and training 
logs... It looks like they hit a slump.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Both Monthly Twinkle and the training 
books. 
The pages inside are all torn up.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
...They took out their frustration over 
losing on them. 
If you think of it as a past that was too 
hard to accept and that they just wanted 
to crush into oblivion...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: That must be it.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
When you lose, you get all irritated, 
pissed off, and like 'GRAAAHHH!' 
It makes you wanna chomp on something like 
crazy.

text_block_list.name: Samson Big
text_block_list.text:
The Umamusume sneaking in here were 
venting 
the frustration of their defeats.

text_block_list.name: Samson Big
text_block_list.text:
If that's the case, I think I understand 
why it had to be the storage room. 
They needed the race and training records 
kept here.

text_block_list.name: Samson Big
text_block_list.text:
You can find courage watching an Umamusume 
make a comeback. 
And seeing one struggle lets you know 
you're not the only one.

text_block_list.name: Samson Big
text_block_list.text:
I bet that's the kind of support they were 
looking for. 
Defeated, frustrated, completely worn 
down...

text_block_list.name: Samson Big
text_block_list.text: All so they could stand back up again!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
I see... Indeed, I can relate to that 
feeling myself.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Failing to achieve the results you hoped 
for, watching the path to your goals get 
cut off... 
How immense that disappointment and 
frustration must be...

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
To let those emotions out, to lean on 
something and get back on their feet... 
This room is a necessary place for the 
students of Tracen Academy.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
—For now, the intruders' objective has 
been identified. 
We also have leads on potential suspects, 
sir! ...However—

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
...Is simply apprehending them the right 
conclusion? 
And what should be done regarding the 
storage room itself...?

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Everyone, my apologies. Please grant me 
some time to consider our future policy. 
Until then, I request that we temporarily 
suspend the investigation!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: —Or so the Captain said, anyway.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Wouldn't talking directly to the Umamusume 
sneaking in 
be the best way to figure out what to do?

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
I get why they'd hesitate to check out the 
key, but... 
If this keeps up, they might lose access 
to the storage room entirely!

text_block_list.name: Samson Big
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure they want to avoid that too! 
Let's stake the place out and negotiate 
directly!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, this is kinda exciting! 
But is it really okay to do this without 
telling the Cap'n?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
No need to worry! If Windy-chan and the 
gang solve this, 
Fenomeno won't have anything to complain 
about!
